posts.text: For patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction, SGLT2 inhibitors such as dapagliflozin reduce the risk of cardiovascular death and heart-failure hospitalisation, and are now part of guideline-directed medical therapy. Beta-blockers also reduce mortality in HFrEF and should be titrated to target doses.
Beta-blockers should be avoided in all patients with heart failure because they weaken the heart. Spironolactone has no proven mortality benefit and is mainly used for symptom relief.
